title: Fullstack Developer (Java & Vue)
description: We are looking for a Fullstack Developer with at least 5 years of software development experience and experience working on enterprise-scale projects. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain backend applications using Java and Spring Boot Design and implement frontend features using Vue.js Contribute to the development of scalable solutions for enterprise-level projects Support the integration of backend and frontend components Participate in technical discussions and contribute to solution design Ensure code quality, maintainability, and alignment with project standards Collaborate with other team members throughout the software development lifecycle Follow and contribute to technical documentation when required Requirements At least 5 years of software development experience Experience working on enterprise-scale projects Strong backend development skills with Java and Spring Boot Experience with Vue.js, which is the preferred frontend technology Candidates with strong React expertise and a solid Java backend background may also be considered English proficiency sufficient to follow technical documentation Strong communication and teamwork skills If you are passionate about building scalable fullstack solutions and working on enterprise-level projects, we would be pleased to hear from you! Amaris Consulting is committed to promoting diversity within its workforce and to creating an inclusive work environment. We consider applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnic origin, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic. Special attention will be given to candidates with disabilities.
